title: Kinematics
summary: Wheel speeds to robot speeds, the WPILib way.

steps.title: Wheel speeds in, robot speeds out
steps.say: `DifferentialDriveKinematics` does the math you wrote by hand last lesson.

steps.title: Open DifferentialDriveMech.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `DifferentialDriveMech` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find getChassisSpeeds
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+F** and search for `getChassisSpeeds`, then fill it in.

steps.title: Start the robot
steps.say: Your code only runs once it's built and started.

waitFor.hint: press Start and wait for Running.

steps.title: Enable in Teleop
steps.say: Pick **Teleop** and press **Enable**. Robot code runs only while it's enabled.

steps.title: WPILib's answer
steps.say: Drive around. In AdvantageScope, search for `LinearSpeed`, then drag **Drive/LinearSpeed** onto the **Left Axis**.

steps.title: Your answer
steps.say: Your DriveMath version should sit right on top of it. In AdvantageScope, search for `LinearSpeedByHand`, then drag **Drive/LinearSpeedByHand** onto the **Right Axis**.
